title: `nerv kaji promote`: stop the service, verify and swap
goal: The owner promotes a standby with one command whose safety inputs come from verified records, not from the caller
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: nerv kaji promote stops the running service (serve swap-quiesce guard) before the file swap and restarts it after (test)

Inside the function, main base, new epoch, previous main and the old main public key are derived from verified registry records; lastAckMs from standby_lease_state; the drain receipt from a file (tests)

An unplanned promotion needs every unrevoked base other than this one to acknowledge the new epoch push and, unless the old main acknowledged, a root-signed revoke of the old main; the owner's word alone never suffices; a re-run after a crash resumes (tests)
validation: Directed regressions in the named test files
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress
